subject.title: fix: gateway boots when a configured plugin payload is broken

question: Should a known enabled plugin whose installed payload fails verification make gateway startup fail closed, or should OpenClaw boot with that plugin explicitly configured-unavailable?
rationale: Current main deliberately preserved fail-closed behavior in the merged parent while deferring this exact availability tradeoff; source review cannot safely choose the product and operational contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve bounded quarantine after rebase
options.body: Adopt degraded boot only for verified, known plugin owners, with a visible configured-unavailable diagnostic and real runtime proof of the post-rebase behavior.

options.title: Retain fail-closed startup
options.body: Keep current main's startup behavior and close or narrow this PR to diagnostic improvements already delivered by the parent.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded quarantine after rebase
recommendation.body: Adopt degraded boot only for verified, known plugin owners, with a visible configured-unavailable diagnostic and real runtime proof of the post-rebase behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only evidenced recent contributor across both the merged parent and this proposed continuation; maintainer sponsorship is still required for the policy choice.
